decisions.reason: This training programme builds directly on the firm's existing training and application-support capabilities, so its strong in-house R&D and customer know-how make it easy to refine and exploit commercially.

As an accessory closely tied to the firm's modular milling equipment, the fourth rotary axis fits its established engineering base and service model, though its more limited website prominence suggests a somewhat narrower niche.

Hybrid additive post-processing is relatively distant from the firm's established knowledge base, so even with solid R&D the firm is less able to interpret market feedback and improve it efficiently than for core products.

A high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the center of the firm's core competences in precision machining, making it highly compatible with its accumulated knowledge, testing infrastructure, and customer base.

The automatic tool change system extends the firm's existing machinery and productivity solutions, and its engineering, application expertise, and installed-base service network support continued development and market retention.
